326.reason: no keys: the package takes and generates no key material; operands are single bits and short bit vectors, not key bytes of a fixed strength

327.reason: boolean logic: package implements logic gates and combinational blocks over single-bit values only, no cipher, hash or MAC

407.reason: bounded work per call: a gate is a fixed number of CMOS evaluations, an n-input gate or multiplexer is linear in its inputs, and a decoder or demultiplexer produces 2^n lines for at most 16 inputs (a width cap enforced by a panic); no other input-dependent iteration
